name: geosilo_decode
description: Decodes a raw GEOSILO-formatted BLOB into a GEOMETRY. Provided for backward compatibility with values stored as BLOB rather than the GEOSILO type.

examples.code: SELECT geosilo_decode(blob_col) FROM (SELECT geosilo_encode(ST_Point(1, 2)) AS blob_col) t;

name: geosilo_metadata
returnType: STRUCT(geometry_type VARCHAR, vertex_type VARCHAR, scale BIGINT)
description: Reads the GEOSILO header without decoding the geometry. Returns a STRUCT with geometry_type (POINT, LINESTRING, ...), vertex_type (XY, XYZ, XYM, XYZM), and scale (the integer scale factor used at encode time).

name: geosilo_encode
description: Encodes a GEOMETRY into GEOSILO using a caller-supplied integer scale. Each coordinate is multiplied by `scale` and rounded to a 32-bit integer before delta-encoding, so a scale of 1e6 keeps 6 decimal digits of precision, 1e7 keeps 7, etc. Larger scales preserve more precision; `scale` must be positive, and encoding fails if any scaled coordinate falls outside the 32-bit integer range (about ±214 at scale 1e7, ±21,474,836 at scale 100).

name: geosilo_decode
description: Decodes a GEOSILO value back into a DuckDB GEOMETRY. Round-trips losslessly when the original was encoded at sufficient scale.

examples.code: SELECT geosilo_decode(silo_col) FROM (SELECT ST_Point(1, 2)::GEOSILO AS silo_col) t;

name: geosilo_encode
description: Encodes a GEOMETRY value into the compact GEOSILO binary format. When the GEOMETRY carries CRS metadata, an appropriate integer scale is derived from the CRS (e.g. degree-based CRSes get higher precision than projected meter-based ones); otherwise a default scale of 10,000,000 (1e7) is used. Returns a BLOB; cast it to GEOSILO (`geosilo_encode(...)::GEOSILO`, which validates the header) to use it with the GEOSILO ST_* overloads. geosilo_decode and geosilo_metadata also accept the BLOB directly.

name: geosilo_metadata
returnType: STRUCT(geometry_type VARCHAR, vertex_type VARCHAR, scale BIGINT)
description: Reads the GEOSILO header without decoding the geometry. Returns a STRUCT with geometry_type (POINT, LINESTRING, ...), vertex_type (XY, XYZ, XYM, XYZM), and scale (the integer scale factor used at encode time).

name: geosilo_is_valid
description: Returns true when the value is a structurally valid GEOSILO blob: a known header, element counts consistent with the data, supported nesting depth and no trailing bytes. Never raises an error for malformed input, so it can be used to filter untrusted BLOBs before decoding.

name: geosilo_is_valid
description: Returns true when the value is a structurally valid GEOSILO blob: a known header, element counts consistent with the data, supported nesting depth and no trailing bytes. Never raises an error for malformed input, so it can be used to filter untrusted BLOBs before decoding.

name: geosilo_validate
description: Validates a GEOSILO blob and returns NULL when it is valid, otherwise a message describing the first problem found (truncated data, bad magic byte, unsupported version, invalid count, ...).

name: try_geosilo_decode
description: Decodes a GEOSILO blob into a GEOMETRY like geosilo_decode, but returns NULL instead of raising an error when the blob is malformed.

name: try_geosilo_decode
description: Decodes a GEOSILO blob into a GEOMETRY like geosilo_decode, but returns NULL instead of raising an error when the blob is malformed.

name: ST_Area
description: Returns the planar area of the polygonal parts of the geometry in the units of its coordinate system (exterior ring area minus hole area, summed over all polygons, including those inside a GEOMETRYCOLLECTION). Returns 0 for points and linestrings.

name: ST_GeometryType
description: Returns the geometry type name (POINT, LINESTRING, POLYGON, MULTIPOINT, MULTILINESTRING, MULTIPOLYGON, GEOMETRYCOLLECTION) by reading the GEOSILO header — no full decode is performed.

name: ST_IsEmpty
description: Returns true if the encoded geometry contains no coordinates. Reads only the header and the top-level vertex/part count.

name: ST_Length
description: Returns the planar length of the linear parts of the geometry (LINESTRING, MULTILINESTRING and linestrings inside a GEOMETRYCOLLECTION) in the units of its coordinate system. Returns 0 for points and polygons (use ST_Perimeter for polygon boundaries).

name: ST_NPoints
description: Returns the total number of vertices in the encoded geometry, including all rings and sub-geometries (polygon rings count their closing vertex, empty points count as 0).

name: ST_Perimeter
description: Returns the planar perimeter of the polygonal parts of the geometry, summed across all rings (holes included). Returns 0 for points and linestrings.

name: ST_X
description: Returns the X coordinate of a POINT geometry. Returns NULL for an empty POINT and raises an error for non-POINT geometries.

name: ST_XMax
description: Returns the maximum X coordinate of the geometry's bounding box, or NULL for an empty geometry.

name: ST_XMin
description: Returns the minimum X coordinate of the geometry's bounding box, or NULL for an empty geometry.

name: ST_Y
description: Returns the Y coordinate of a POINT geometry. Returns NULL for an empty POINT and raises an error for non-POINT geometries.

name: ST_YMax
description: Returns the maximum Y coordinate of the geometry's bounding box, or NULL for an empty geometry.

name: ST_YMin
description: Returns the minimum Y coordinate of the geometry's bounding box, or NULL for an empty geometry.
